描述_EN: after firing, the design acquired a silvery colour, making a pleasant contrast with the black ground. in this example dated to the jin dynasty (1115-1234) the black iron-rich glaze is painted with a glaze containing a slightly different iron oxide content. this vase was donated in 1934 by bluett & sons, one of the most established commercial firms dealing in chinese antiquities in londo. kilns in northern china have a long tradition of producing blackwares with iron-rich glazes and distinct surface effects.
描述_ZN: 烧制后，图案获得了银色的颜色，与黑地形成了愉快的对比。 在这个年代为金代（1115-1234）的例子中，富含铁的黑色釉面被涂上了含有稍微不同的氧化铁的釉面。 这个花瓶是在1934年由Bluett & sons捐赠的，Bluett & sons是Londo最著名的中国古董商业公司之一。 中国北方的窑厂有生产黑陶的悠久传统，釉面富含铁质，表面效果明显。
